title: Bio Hub
subtitle: CZU Prague · Fundamentals of Biology
intro: Fundamentals of Biology (ZEX108E) at CZU Prague, all 12 lectures in one place. The exam is a written test of 24 questions based only on the lectures, with 3 exam terms. Lessons in small bites, flashcards, games, mock tests and review.
footer: Built from the ZEX108E lecture slides (Mandák, Černý, Panská, Dvořák, Krak, Kocourková, Bílý, Růžička; CZU Faculty of Environmental Sciences). Facts follow the slides; if anything here disagrees with the slides, the slides win.

tests.title: Final exam · 24-question test
tests.sub: A written test of 24 questions based only on the lectures. 3 exam terms; if you first come on the last listed term, you don't get two more. Pass mark and time limit are not published. Dates are in UIS.
